title: Item:Ogre Khan's Skull
wikitext:
[[File:QuestItem OgreKhansSkull.png|right]]

'''Ogre Khan's Skull''' can be found in [[Bring Me the Head of Ghola-Fan!]] after Ghola-Fan is defeated. Go left from Ghola-Fan's throne room and check the bone pile. Ogre Khan's Skull is used in the underground passages in the Restless Isles to reach the [[The Restless Isles#Volcano's Mouth|Volcano's Mouth]] the location of [[The Twilight Forge]].
